sources.entry: Claude Codex Settings by fatih akyon - A well-organized, well-written set of plugins covering core developer activities, such as working with common cloud platforms like GitHub, Azure, MongoDB, and popular services such as Tavily, Playwright, and more. Clear, not overly-opinionated, and compatible with a few other providers.

summary.one_liner: A collection of installable plugins, skills, hooks, subagents, and MCP-related setup for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Cursor, covering developer tooling and third-party services.
summary.what_it_does: The repo packages many plugins that each bundle skills, slash commands, agents, hooks, or output styles for AI coding tools. Core plugins include simplify (reviews changed code for reuse and over-engineering), humanize (a hook that blocks AI-sounding buzzwords and em-dashes in writes), and advisor plugins that get a second opinion from another model via the Claude or Codex CLI. Other plugins bundle vendor skill sets for MongoDB, Supabase, Stripe, Polar, Cloudflare, Hetzner, Dokploy, OpenObserve, LiveKit, React/Next.js, and browser automation through agent-browser. Document plugins cover PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint from Anthropic and OpenAI, and python-skills provides Python style guidance. Plugins are installed through a marketplace command for each tool, and many can also be added with the npx skills CLI. The README notes that some skills are ZIP downloads for claude.ai, ChatGPT, and other apps.
use_cases: Add vendor-maintained skills for MongoDB, Supabase, Stripe, or Cloudflare to a coding agent
Review and simplify changed code before committing
Get a second opinion from another model on a plan
Block AI-sounding phrasing in written files and commits
Automate git commits, pull requests, and PR review
Create PDF, Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files with agent skills
notable: One marketplace with per-tool install commands for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Cursor
Hooks that enforce rules, such as humanize blocking buzzwords and simplify gating commits
Advisor plugins that call a second model through the Claude or Codex CLI for cross-model review
Bundles official vendor skill sets from Anthropic, OpenAI, MongoDB, Stripe, Cloudflare, and others
caveats: Many plugins are Claude Code only; hooks and some features are not available in Codex, Cursor, or Gemini CLI
Advisor plugins need the Codex CLI signed in or an authenticated Claude Code CLI
Some plugins require prerequisites described in INSTALL.md, and some services need accounts or API keys
